description: This file contains the AddressFormat class which provides CRUD operations and retrieval methods for address format data in an OpenCart-based e-commerce system. It includes methods to add, edit, delete, and fetch address format records from the database, as well as get total counts. It is a model class used within the administrative localization module.

classes.name: AddressFormat
classes.description: A model class for managing address format records in the database, including creating, updating, deleting, and retrieving address formats.

methods.name: addAddressFormat
methods.description: Inserts a new address format record into the database and returns its ID.

methods.name: editAddressFormat
methods.description: Updates an existing address format record identified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteAddressFormat
methods.description: Deletes an address format record by its ID.

methods.name: getAddressFormat
methods.description: Retrieves a single address format record by its ID.

methods.name: getAddressFormats
methods.description: Retrieves multiple address format records with optional start and limit filters.

methods.name: getTotalAddressFormats
methods.description: Returns the total count of address format records, optionally filtered.
